world_grains_voronoi — SEGMENTATION world op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.world_grains_voronoi(n: 'int' = 36, seed: 'int' = 0, *, size=(192, 192), jitter: 'float' = 0.8, boundary_width: 'float' = 1.5, noise: 'float' = 0.02) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segworld; segworld.world_grains_voronoi(n: 'int' = 36, seed: 'int' = 0, *, size=(192, 192), jitter: 'float' = 0.8, boundary_width: 'float' = 1.5, noise: 'float' = 0.02) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("world_grains_voronoi"))

Usage

Voronoi grain world: n jittered seeds on a lattice; labels = index of the nearest seed (1..n) (world_grains_voronoi).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

画像 = 粒ごとの明るさ(0.4〜0.75)× 粒界の暗い線(幅 boundary_width、粒界までの距離の閉形式で描く)+ 雑音。背景は無い(全画素がどれかの粒)。

返り値: image、labels、edge_distance(各画素から粒界までの距離)、truth = {n、seeds (n, 2)、areas (多角形、靴紐)、edge_length_total(内部の辺の長さの和)、n_edges、polygons、boundary_width、total_area = H·W}。
